en.title: Agni Hotra
en.subtitle: Fire Blessing Ritual
en.description: Ceremonial fire ritual where unwanted energy/intentions are offered into sacred fire for transformation. Guest meditates in ceremonial fire space while priest chants mantras and rings bell, offering grain/food into the flames to release mental blockages.
en.highlightText: Releases unwanted energy/aspects, helps manifest new intentions. Balances energy, voice and mind

en.title: Tirta Ening (Melukat)
en.subtitle: Water Purification and Spiritual Blessed
en.description: A traditional Balinese Hindu purification ritual involving the use of holy water (tirta) to cleanse the body, mind, and spirit of negative energy, bad luck, or spiritual impurities. It's typically performed at a sacred spring, waterfall, or temple, led by a Balinese priest, Dressed in Balinese attire, guest will guided to standing beneath a row of carved water spouts while offering prayers and letting the water flow over the head and body
en.highlightText: it's a genuine spiritual experience meant to release negative energy, clear the mind, and restore a sense of balance and renewal

en.title: Moonlight Remedies
en.subtitle: Fullmoon Cleansing Ritual
en.description: Praying ritual at the selected local temple dedicated to Goddess Sang Hyang Chandra (Moon God) for seeking spiritual wellbeing and dispelling negativity. Guided by Local Hindu Priest, guest will also learn how to make an offering (Canang Sari) before the praying sessions start.
en.highlightText: Balinese cosmology holds that at fullmoon, the connection between the physical world (sekala) and the unseen spiritual world (niskala) is at its clearest, so prayers and offerings are believed to carry more power and be more likely to reach the gods and ancestors

en.title: Balinese Chakra Balancing
en.subtitle: Open Aura, Balancing Chakra, and Trauma Healing
en.description: Embark on a holistic journey of healing and self discovery to unlock the wisdom of your soul through palmistry, numerology, open your inner aura, and balancing your 7 chakras. This sessions followed by a deep trauma healing and purification blessing ceremony to renewal your soul.
en.highlightText: Release the weight of past burben, anxiety, and trauma. Healing begins when you let go of what no longer serves you, allowing space for peace, strength, and renewal

venues: Private Signature at COMO Shambala Uma, Ubud

en.title: Kundalini Chakra Healing
en.subtitle: Energy Healing and Balancing Chakra by Master Dewa Made Sulendra
en.description: During this sessions, Master Dewa energetically scans the body to identify problem areas and acts as a conduit to focus universal energy on healing and balancing the chakras. Rebalancing your chakras can improve your mood and energy levels, alleviate physical symptoms associated with stress and anxiety, and boost self-esteem.
en.highlightText: Dewa is a Balinese-born healer specializing in Kundalini energy and chakra healing. As a traditional Balinese healer, he draws upon his universal connection to offer insights into various situations, creating opportunities for self-healing.

venues: Private Balinese house at Sukawati Village

en.title: Balinese Energy Healing
en.subtitle: Practice and restore energy healing by Jero Mangku Gede Eka Sukawati
en.description: The methods of Jero Mangku Eka healing is included removing bad spirit with improving cakra point and kundalini. Healing treatment is combined with massage and herbs plans oil. Not only cleaning energy spirit, on healing methode Jero Mangku also help to improve and maintenance the cetral nervous which is panic and stress triggers.
en.highlightText: Blessing ritual and energy purification will reduce your bad spirit and nightmare. Restore spiritual energy to be more present and express gratitude

en.title: Floating Reiki Energy Healing
en.subtitle: Water Healing Treatment through Energy (Reiki Treatment)
en.description: Experience the traditional art of Reiki, reimagined in the gentle embrace of warm water. Floating Reiki invites you into a heated pool with relaxing underwater music, where gravity ceases to exist. As you float, you will drift into a state of total weightlessness while the practitioner transfers universal life force energy through their hands, either by placing them gently on various body parts or hovering them just above.
en.highlightText: The water’s conductive nature allows this energy to flow even more freely, softening your muscles and allowing your nervous system to fully surrender.

en.title: Sacred Sound Of Surya
en.subtitle: Sound Healing (Quantum Sound Dome) by Udara Bali
en.description: Lies and relax in immersive dome space while gongs/singing bowls create resonant sound bath and some sacred chanting. This session combining multiple sound bath formats using artisan gongs, singing bowls and indigenous instruments in dedicated 'Domes at Udara Bali
en.highlightText: Sound Healing to Relaxation, stress relief, energy field balancing, clearing blockages

en.title: Sacred Chant Meditation
en.subtitle: The practice of Sacred Chant by Master Ketut Arsana
en.description: Sacred chant meditation using a harmonium with mantras is a powerful and transformative practice that combines ancient eastern traditions with the healing power of sound. In this practice, a harmonium is used to create beautiful and uplifting melodies that accompany the recitation of mantras.
en.highlightText: A sacred chant or mantra is a powerful sound, word, or phrase repeated to focus the mind, calm the spirit, and connect with higher consciousness. This practice can help reduces stress, deepens focus and brings energy balance.

venues: Signature Private of Pyramids of Chi Wellness, Ubud

en.title: Ancient Sound Healing
en.subtitle: A Mystical and Ethereal Sound Healing Experience by Pyramids of Chi
en.description: An Ancient Sound Healing session invites you into an effortless state of deep relaxation. The process requiring nothing but your presence to be fully received. The rhythmic frequencies of ancient instruments merge with the multi-instrumental talents to create an ocean of vibration. These waves of sound resonate with your DNA, and align your chakra system, supporting your body’s innate intelligence to feel, release, heal, and deeply relax.
en.highlightText: You will drop into a deep, meditative state allowing your body’s innate ability to heal itself take over, leaving you rejuvenated. These deep, meditative states increase our ability to receive messages that cannot be perceived during our busy, daily lives.

en.title: Crystals Sound Bath Meditation
en.subtitle: Sound bath Meditation
en.description: Sound-based purification session with Tibetan singing bowls and crystals for chakra/energy cleansing. Guest lies down while healer plays singing bowls/crystal tones for vibrational cleansing. Immerse your mind and body with the calming sound frequency that will guide you through the 60 minutes journey full of relaxation and reflection.
en.highlightText: The Benefit of sound bath session is for the energetic cleansing, relaxation, and chakra balance

en.title: Floating Sound Bath Meditation
en.subtitle: Water Pool Sound bath Meditation by Sawitry
en.description: a unique practice that elevates deep relaxation by combining the gentle support of water with the healing power of sound. Water acts as a natural amplifier and conductor. As sounds of Tibetan bowl permeate the air, they also travel through the water, allowing the frequencies to gently penetrate every cell of your body.
en.highlightText: This state of effortless floating allows you to fully surrender, as the healing vibrations of sound work their magic.

en.title: Sacred Resonance Of Laughter
en.subtitle: The practice of Kundalini Tantra Yoga by Master Ketut Arsana
en.description: The traditional boundaries of spiritual practice were dissolved not by silence, but by the transformative power of a belly laugh. This yoga exercice integrated intentional laughter exercises into the flow of movement. The shala erupted into a sea of spontaneous giggles that soon blossomed into roars of uninhibited joy
en.highlightText: This biochemical medicine yoga practice was designed to flood the body with endorphins while simultaneously flushing out the shadow of cortisol.

en.title: Sacred Nap Meditation
en.subtitle: Mantra Chanting & Singing Bowl Sound Healing by Heny Ferawati
en.description: It takes you back to experience the beautiful feeling as a baby, combined with powerful healing of sacred chanting and singing bowl, engaging your inner self with the nature around you. Most Balinese mothers rock their babies to sleep using a batik sling, singing traditional lullaby songs and telling a story until the baby falls asleep. Instead of a batik sling, we use 100 percent pure silk hammocks
en.highlightText: This Sacred Nap drives you into Deep relaxation condition, which is good for boosting immunity, and maintaining healthy blood pressure, heart and brain circulation.

en.title: Ice Breathwork Immersion
en.subtitle: Guided Breathwork with Ice Bath Experience
en.description: Through deep, rhythmic breathing, you will elevate your energetic frequency and flood your body with life-force energy. Following the breathwork, you will take this new mental clarity directly into the cold. Learn to be comfortable in the uncomfortable and overcoming intense physical challenges. Through relaxing breathing technique, you will guided to face your fears, breakthrough internal barriers, and reach a state of pure bliss in the ice-revealing your true, potent power from within.
en.highlightText: Inspired by the Wim Hof Method, this powerful session helps you release limiting beliefs, clear emotional clutter, and step out of your head and into your body

en.title: AMA Multisensory Dome
en.subtitle: A PLANETARIUM FOR YOUR INNER UNIVERSE
en.description: AMA is an immersive projection mapping experience where art, sound, and technology converge to create an environment for deep rest, sensory exploration, and expanded awareness. Within the custom-designed Dome, high-resolution visuals unfold across the entire field of vision, transforming the architecture into a living canvas of light and motion.
en.highlightText: Spatial sound, subtle scent, and gentle vibration combine to create a carefully orchestrated sensory environment that encourages stillness, presence, and immersion.

en.title: Kundalini Tantra Yoga
en.subtitle: Yoga Practice by Master Ketut Arsana
en.description: This healing Yoga uses tantra movements along with pranayama (breath) at the same time. The combined techniques are important for energy raising, flowing, moving and balancing. Tantra raises the energy and can be used in your life. With this technique people can in a short time feel the energy working internally and make the glands active.
en.highlightText: In Kundalini Tantra Yoga we all move together in a movement, the energy flowing, using the body as a Yantra to receive and create energy – God energy.

en.title: Pranayama Yoga
en.subtitle: Yoga and practice of breathing exercises
en.description: Pranayama is the formal practice of breathing exercises with the aim to control (= ) the vital life force (= ). With various kinds of practices, we learn to regulate, deepen, refine and guide the breath in a conscious way. Pranayama can be a standalone practice; it can be integrated into a yoga class or it can be used in preparation for meditation.
en.highlightText: Every inhalation provides us with fresh oxygen that is necessary to create energy in the cells and every exhalation helps to expel waste material such as carbon dioxide.

en.title: Hatha Yoga
en.subtitle: Yoga Practice and Movement
en.description: Hatha Flow is a gentle and traditional form of yoga that focuses on the balance of physical postures and breath control. In contrast to Vinyasa, Hatha Flow involves holding poses for a longer duration, promoting stability, alignment, and relaxation. This practice aims to cultivate a sense of harmony between body and mind through deliberate and mindful movements.
en.highlightText: The slower pace of the class gives space for exploring the proper alignment of each pose and for harmonizing the connection between body, breath and mind.

en.title: Vinyasa Yoga
en.subtitle: Yoga Practice and Movement
en.description: Vinyasa Flow is a dynamic style of yoga that seamlessly synchronizes breath with movement, creating a continuous and flowing sequence of poses. It emphasizes the connection between breath and postures, promoting flexibility, strength, and mindfulness. Vinyasa classes typically offer a creative and varied sequence, making each session a unique and invigorating experience.
en.highlightText: Vinyasa yoga links smooth physical movement with deep breathing. It builds full-body strength, improves joint flexibility, supports heart health, and lowers stress through focused, continuous flow

en.title: Yin Yoga
en.subtitle: Yoga Practice and Movement
en.description: Yin Yoga focuses on gentle, seated and reclined postures that are held for longer periods of time, ranging from 1 to 5 minutes. A therapeutic style of yoga where asana/poses are practiced on or lower to the ground for gravity to help go deep in poses. Focus is placed on the breath as an important integration to allow the body to unwind and to release tension.
en.highlightText: This practice encourages stillness and silent introspection, targeting your connective tissues, ligaments, and joints that normally aren't exercised as much in more active styles of physical yoga practice.

en.title: Aqua Yoga
en.subtitle: Yoga Practice and Movement
en.description: Aqua Yoga combines the traditional principles and postures of yoga with the unique properties of water, such as buoyancy, resistance, and hydrostatic pressure. Moving through water provides natural, gentle resistance in all directions. This helps to strengthen muscles without the need for heavy weights, building tone and endurance
en.highlightText: The water supports a significant portion of your body weight (up to 70% in chest-deep water),reducing impact on joints like knees, hips, and ankles. This makes it ideal for individuals with joint pain, arthritis, injuries, or those recovering from surgery.

en.title: Aerial Yoga
en.subtitle: Yoga Practice and Movement
en.description: Aerial silk hammock yoga juicy stretches and exercises to strengthen the muscles with standing and balancing poses, forward folds and back bends, side stretches, twists, inversions and relaxation. This yoga practice allowing your body to fly above the mat and even to hang upside down with the fabric wrapped around you
en.highlightText: Aerial Yoga practice help you to build strength and increase flexibility as well as improve your balance and overall postural stability. As other forms of Yoga it helps you increase mobility, tone your muscles and realign your joints

en.title: Qi Gong
en.subtitle: Yoga Practice and Movement
en.description: The mental aspect of this training is stepping into a state of calm, relaxation and stillness. This approach to Qi Gong is in marrying the body awareness, sensitivity, power and structural alignment of the martial tradition, with health and greater spiritual openings. Qigong movements are generally less complex and can be adapted to suit individuals with physical limitations or injuries
en.highlightText: Benefits of Qi gong include integration of the movements of the physical system into one harmonious unit, grounding into the earth energy, awareness and correction of old mind and trauma patterns, and safely building internal strength

en.title: Ecstatic Dance
en.subtitle: Group Community Dance Movement Meditation At Yoga Barn
en.description: a vibrant form of expression rooted in our ancestral heritage and cultural diversity, celebrates the freedom of movement in its purest form, transcending traditional dance norms of routines and steps. This practice offers a liberating space for anyone to step onto the dance floor and immerse themselves in a world of self-expression, helping to release limitations and embrace comfort in both body and personality.
en.highlightText: Ecstatic dance offers powerful mental, emotional, and physical benefits through free-form, unchoreographed movement in a safe, judgment-free space. It increase mood enhancement, Anxiety, Stress Release, and deep relaxation

en.title: Elysian Head Spa
en.subtitle: Scalp Treatment
en.description: Step into a heavenly state of deep relaxation with Elysian Head Spa, an Om Ham signature water healing treatment. This treatment combining flowing water therapy with modern scalp care. This experience is designed to release tension, nourish the scalp, and restore inner balance.
en.highlightText: Elysian Head Spa provides deep scalp cleansing, tension relief, and targeted hair restoration solutions tailored to individual needs. Impoved Circulation and growth, stress tension release, and hair restoration.

en.title: Buddha Kecapi Massage
en.subtitle: Healing Treatment by Master Ketut Arsana
en.description: Buddha Kecapi means, “Inner light healing inspired by love”. An intuitive healing treatment in which Master Ketut Arsana combined energy balancing, with therapeutic massage, chakra healing and as a final touch, Prana will be channeling to harmonize energy within. He performs a body scan, intuitively discovering specific areas that need attentions in specific client conditions, bellow treatments may occur in this session
en.highlightText: Elysian Head Spa provides deep scalp cleansing, tension relief, and targeted hair restoration solutions tailored to individual needs. Impoved Circulation and growth, stress tension release, and hair restoration.

en.title: Sea Salt Detox Spa
en.subtitle: Spa and Body Treatment
en.description: Aimed at awakening your senses with daily yoga classes and becoming more in tune with your bodies needs through detailed food plans and fasting. Explore the daily Kundalini Tantra Yoga, Neti Pot Practice and Diet Detox Programs Designed to eliminate toxins from the body, involved a period of fasting and followed by a strict diet of fruit, vegetables, juices, herbs, teas, and water. for the body.
en.highlightText: A sea salt spa treatment exfoliates your skin, relaxes your muscles, and reduces stress

en.title: Boreh Rejuvination Ritual
en.subtitle: Lymphatic Boreh Body Treatment
en.description: This treatment combines relaxing massage with revitalizing full body massage to stimulate circulation; followed by medicinal herbal scrub for the lymphatic system. This herbal scrub is rubbed all over the skin creating a sensation of ‘pins and needles ‘and gentle heat. Your treatment will be completed with a special spice bath.
en.highlightText: A lymphatic boreh spa combines gentle lymphatic massage with a warming Balinese spice paste to detoxify your body, boost circulation, and relieve deep muscle ache

en.title: Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy
en.subtitle: Jetlag Remedy Treatment
en.description: Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy (HBOT) is considered an effective, evidence-backed, and increasingly popular remedy for combating the symptoms of jet lag. By delivering 100% pure oxygen in a pressurized chamber, HBOT reverses the oxygen deprivation caused by flying at high altitudes, helping travelers recover faster, improve sleep, and eliminate brain fog
en.highlightText: This therapy have a multitude of benefits, including enhanced concentration, a fortified immune system, radiant glowing skin and boosted energy levels.

en.title: Balinese Jetlag Remedies
en.subtitle: Balinese Massage & Relaxation
en.description: Combining gentle and strong balinese massage incorporating meridian point acupressure and yogic stretching then followed by a hot herbal cloth that is applied along the spine. This session begin with sound healing to harmonize the energy within. The relaxation session restore your fatigue, good for reduce jetlag from long distance travel.
en.highlightText: Traditional and herbal spices using to scrubs your body during the massage process will relief tension and stimulate blood circulation.

venues: Bali Botanica by Oneworld Ayurveda, Ubud

en.title: Shanthi Ayurvedic
en.subtitle: 3 days of Sleep & Strees Relief Treatment Program by Bali Botanica
en.description: Ayurveda emphasizes mental well-being as the foundation of good health. Trouble sleeping is the signs of Vata Imbalance, a primary life force in Ayurveda that controls movement, breathing, blood flow, and thoughts in the body. This program can help address these condition to help you feel better rested, more balanced and less stressed
en.highlightText: This treatment combining full body massage, with steam chamber relaxing, cooling remedy, and pouring medical oil in a continuous stream over the forehead for calming the nervous system and reduce insomnia

venues: Bali Botanica by Oneworld Ayurveda, Ubud

en.title: Niruja Ayurvedic
en.subtitle: 3 days of Muscle & Joint Healing Treatment Program by Bali Botanica
en.description: Healthy muscle, bones, and joint are essential for freedom of movement. Viata imbalances are associated with joint disorders, while Pitta imbalance are tied to inflammation, muscle pain, sprains, and acute pain episodes. Kapha imbalances result in muscle and morning stiffness
en.highlightText: Ayurvedic treatments effectively aid conditions like arthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, spinal problems, and sport injuries.

en.title: Panchakarma Retreat
en.subtitle: 7 Days of Luxury Ayurvedic Retreat Signature by YARA Wellness
en.description: This Ayurvedic Retreat follows a personalised, step by-step Panchakarma healing program designed around your individual constitution (Prakriti) and current imbalances, assessed by a vaidya. This approach starts with detox and body treatment to prepare the next cleansing phase. cleansing procedures are introduced based on a medical assessment. These are the classical five actions of Panchakarma therapy, including 30 days aftercare.
en.highlightText: This Ayurvedic treatments is designed to gently clear accumulated toxins (ama), restore digestive fire (agni), and rebalance the doshas, Vata, Pitta, and Kapha..

en.title: Prema Sambhanda Retreat
en.subtitle: A Five Element Signature journey of conscious connection and heart awakening for couples
en.description: Grounded in the Sanskrit meaning of “Divine Love Connection,” this retreat invites partners to slow down, reflect and realign their union through shared healing, sacred rituals and heart-centred dialogue. The experience blends ancient Balinese wisdom with modern relational practices, creating a nourishing space for couples’ intimacy, connection renewal and conscious communication.
en.highlightText: The Prema Sambandha retreat is a sacred offering for couples seeking to deepen their emotional bond, rekindle intimacy, and communicate with presence and compassion.

en.title: Replenish and Detox Retreat
en.subtitle: 5 Days of detoxification retreat
en.description: Aimed at awakening your senses with daily yoga classes and becoming more in tune with your bodies needs through detailed food plans and fasting. Explore the daily Kundalini Tantra Yoga, Neti Pot Practice and Diet Detox Programs Designed to eliminate toxins from the body, involved a period of fasting and followed by a strict diet of fruit, vegetables, juices, herbs, teas, and water. for the body.
en.highlightText: Through fasting, your body will have time to rest the organs, and effective to stimulate the liver to get rid of toxins, improve body circulation & balance, and provide healthy nutrients

en.title: Wanaprastha Forest Therapy
en.subtitle: Nature Immersion and Forest Theraphy by Forest Therapy Indonesia
en.description: Forest therapy is a holistic medical therapy approach that utilizes the natural power of the forest to maintain physical and mental health, as well as disease prevention, and requires guidance from a forest therapy expert, mental health therapist, or medical/health professional. Combining walking meditation and mindfulness eating this practice inviting one to slow down, breathe deeply, and connecting with living essence of the forest.
en.highlightText: Through this nature immersion, you will get various health benefits for Increasing production of anti-cancer proteins and Assists in weight loss, Lowers blood pressure, Reduces stress, Improves cardiovascular health and metabolism, and deep relaxation

en.title: Waterfall Hydro Therapy
en.subtitle: Nature Immersion and Water Theraphy by Forest Therapy Indonesia
en.description: A guided water-healing experience inspired by the water element and designed for deep restoration. We are led through a gentle sequence of breath awareness, stillness to feel a gently moving water, and meditative moment to notice sensation, weight, temperature, sound, buoyancy, and emotional response in the water, allowing the body to soften and the mind to settle into quiet clarity.
en.highlightText: Research on therapeutic aquatic exercise has found benefits for pain relief, recovery function, quality of life, sleep quality, and overstimulated mind

en.title: Guided Nature Forest Walking
en.subtitle: Forest and Coffee Plantation Trekking by Munduk Molding Plantation
en.description: Embark on a journey through the heart of a coffee plantation and discover the secrets behind producing the finest Arabica coffee. Our expert guides will lead you through the various stages of the coffee-making process, from planting and harvesting to drying, cleaning, roasting, and brewing.
en.highlightText: Forest walking combined with coffee offers a powerful boost to your mind, body, and soul by blending nature's healing elements with a mindful caffeine ritual.

en.title: Zen Harmony Diving
en.subtitle: Mindfulness Scuba Diving by Zen Resort Bali
en.description: Zen Harmony Scuba Diving integrates Yoga, Meditation, Pranayama, and Ayurveda with scuba diving enhancing your health and fitness whilst discovering the amazing beauty and diversity of marine life. The five famous dive sites in North Bali, suited for everyone and all experience levels, are all accessible from Zen Resort, namely Puri Jati and Zen Reef
en.highlightText: Sail along the North Bali coastline taking in the landscape, witness the breath-taking horizon appear with the Sun’s first rays, find the dolphins and watch them play in the morning Sun, whilst you sip Ginger Tea.

en.title: Balinese Herbalism Permaculture
en.subtitle: an introduction to Balinese herbal traditions by Bhakti Garden
en.description: Balinese Herbalism is an exploration of the deep connection between the human body, nature, well-being, and daily wellness practices. You will learn how to identify and use traditional herbs, culminating in the creation of 7 traditional herbal remedies that can be replicated at home using easily sourced substitutes.
en.highlightText: ​Herbalism prioritizes using mineral-rich plants regularly, staying hydrated, nurturing the nervous system, aiding digestion, getting enough rest, and weaving simple rituals into your day, like brewing and drinking tea.

en.title: Farm to Table Dining
en.subtitle: Dining Experience at Begawan Biji Regenerative Farm
en.description: Experience a dining where you can see directly where your food is grown naturally at Begawan Biji Regenerative farm, featuring fresh, locally sourced ingredients from Begawan Biji’s own farm and freshly brewed coffee or selection of tea and herbal infusions from the garden. Immerse yourself in Bali’s traditional rice farming practices and learn the roots of the island’s agricultural heritage on a regenerative farm
en.highlightText: Explore the mandala-shaped permaculture garden, Mansur Heritage rice paddies, nursery, poultry, composting pit, and if you’re lucky, you might even spot the Bali Starlings at the farm

en.title: Atiti Bojana Dining
en.subtitle: Dining Experience at Samsara Living Museum
en.description: Atiti Bojana, meaning 'selected food served to honored guests', the art of serving and consuming food in this style has also been going on since ancient time. Feel the rich and a taste of Eastern Bali flavors in each dish where we prepare specifically through a traditional cooking process. Experience the Balinese Royal Palace dining banquet in the most authentic venue.
en.highlightText: In this authentic Balinese cuisine, guest will invite to prepare sate lilit and sayur liklik, traditional dishes inspired by the palm-leaf manuscript of Dharma Caruban, an ancient manuscript that serves as a traditional guide to Balinese gastronomy, culinary philosophy, and sacred cooking rituals.

en.title: Megibung Dining
en.subtitle: Dining Experience & Village Visit at Tenganan Pengrisingan Village
en.description: Megibung means communal dining or eating together from a shared portion to symbolize unity, equality, and togetherness. This is an ancient tradition from Karangasem in East Bali, dating back to the 17th century when group of people sitting cross-legged in a circle to eat on the same plate. The menu combining rice and traditional side dishes (like, sate, and meats) are piled high on a large tray lined with a banana leaf ( )
en.highlightText: gibungan Tenganan Pegringsingan is one of Bali's oldest traditional villages, Bali Aga, an original indigenous Balinese who kept their ancient traditions before Hindu kingdoms arrived.

venues: Seven Painting at Kaamala Resort Ubud

en.title: Painting Art Fine Dining
en.subtitle: Fine Dining Experience at Seven Painting Ubud
en.description: An immersive dining journey unlike any other, Seven Paintings blends art, storytelling, and gastronomy into a multi-sensory experience. Set in an intimate and theatrical space, each moment is carefully curated to engage the senses transforming dinner into a captivating narrative. Perfect for exclusive gatherings and special occasions, the experience invites guests to step into a world where visuals, flavors, and emotions intertwine
en.highlightText: Drawing inspiration from timeless masterpieces such as Van Gogh’s Starry Night, Da Vinci’s Mona Lisa, Picasso’s Weeping Woman, and other celebrated paintings, this exclusive experience is limited to just six seats per evening, ensuring a setting of intimacy, detail, and personalized connection

en.title: Balinese Theater Fine Dining
en.subtitle: Fine Dining Experience at Gajah Putih Ubud
en.description: Gajah Putih is a luxury restaurant in Ubud, Bali, offering a multi-course tasting menu of Balinese-inspired cuisine paired with a live dinner theatre performance. It offers a unique dining experience in Bali, where you can enjoy a beautiful fine dining set menu, along with an exciting theatre performance.
en.highlightText: Gajah Putih runs two alternating show themes. LINGKARAN, meaning "circle," follows the natural cycle of a Balinese day and leans toward renewal and morning light; MALAM takes the opposite register, built around the mystery and atmosphere of Bali after dark.

en.title: Bali Mula Mindfull Eating
en.subtitle: Ancient Tradition Village Dining Experience at Dapur Bali Mula By Chef Yudi
en.description: Dapur Bali Mula is a unique, traditional open-air dining experience in Les Village, North Bali, that serves ancestral Balinese cuisine cooked over wood fires. The place have no fixed menu: Dishes change daily depending on what local fishermen and farmers bring in from the sea, forest, and fields. The intimate hospitality typical of a host welcoming guests is palpable at Dapur Bali Moela
en.highlightText: You can also witness firsthand the process of making arak (a traditional spirit) and liquid palm sugar (juruh) derived from the lontar (palmyra palm).

en.title: Jamu Herbal Remedies
en.subtitle: an introduction to Jamu herbal making by Made Ayu Aryani
en.description: Creating a jamu herbal drink concoction based on the philosophy of the human life cycle, as symbolized by the Majapahit “Surya Wilwaktita”, an emblem associated with the “Dewata Nawa Sanga”, manifestations of Ida Sang Hyang Widhi Wasa who rule over and guard the nine cardinal directions within the cosmological concept of the Hindu Dharma religion in Bali
en.highlightText: The primary benefits of “jamu” include boosting the immune system, relieving pain, and aiding digestion, thanks to the antioxidants and natural active compounds found in the spices.

en.title: Boreh Herbal Remedies
en.subtitle: Traditional Scrub Making Experience
en.description: Learn how to make Boreh, a traditional scrub especially formulated for the lymphatic system, a ritual originally used by rice farmers to soothe tired muscles and ward off illness. The guests will enjoy an experience of picking the ingredients from our own garden. Boreh scrub made from a potent blend of ground-up herbs and spices. While recipes vary, the mixture typically includes warming ingredients and bound together with rice powder.
en.highlightText: Boreh Made of a combination of traditional organic spices and roots that helps to eliminate dead skin cells making you to feel and look fresh

en.title: Loloh Herbal Remedies
en.subtitle: Loloh Herbal Making based on your numerology character
en.description: passed down for centuries. It is made from natural ingredients such as turmeric, ginger, temulawak, kencur, lemongrass, and various other spices, and is believed to offer many health benefits. Before creating this herbal drink you are invites to experience the Pratiti reading, a Balinese calendar calculations and find meaning of our birth are based on the methodology and conduct consultations on matters deemed to provide a special wellness treatment
en.highlightText: Loloh Cemcem main ingredient is from cemcem leaves (Spondias pinnata, also known as forest kedondong) that aids digestion, relieves bloating or heartburn, and helps lower blood pressure

en.title: Meramban
en.subtitle: Foraging for Medicinal Plant by Made Ayu Aryani
en.description: Foraging for medicinal plants is identifying medicinal plants in our surroundings and engaging the senses to recognize them. Sharing the local names of medicinal plants identified while foraging. This is followed by preparing remedies, understanding the “sad rasa” (six tastes) within them, and grasping the properties and potential of the plants to benefit the body.
en.highlightText: Foraging medicinal plants provides fresh, potent botanical remedies and connects you directly with nature.

venues: Selected Resto in Ubud & Gianyar Area

en.title: Paon Bogha
en.subtitle: Balinese Cooking Class
en.description: Discover the secrets of Balinese food and gastronomy ingredient inspired by the ancient manuscript “Lontar Dharma Caruban”, the definitive scriptural authority on the culinary arts. It outlines the ethics of food processing and provides formulas for seasoning pastes and ceremonial dishes. Our chef will guide you through a homemade interactive Balinese cooking class, we will collect some of the ingredients for our food in our own garden.
en.highlightText: Balinese traditional spice blends (basa genep) are rich in spices scientifically proven to contain active compounds that combat free radicals and boost the body's immunity.

en.title: Pratiti Reading
en.subtitle: Balinese astrology-based wellness session
en.description: Rooted in the science of Jyotisa and the Balinese calendar system, it combines traditional calculations with intuitive interpretation. This Jyotisa methodology will be able to provide a very special wellness treatment through a birth approach called Oton A Pratiti reader will analyze your unique birth date, time, and natural influences to interpret the symbolic patterns that shape your life
en.highlightText: The goal is to foster self-awareness, help you understand your strengths and challenges, and identify ways to balance your emotional and spiritual energies.

en.title: Human Design
en.subtitle: Personal Self-Discovery by Nona Jupiter
en.description: Human Design is a comprehensive system enabling self-discovery, illuminating how individuals function and grow. It aids in navigating diverse traits like talents, weaknesses, and influenced areas, fostering a deeper understanding of oneself. Learning about your Human Design Chart can revolutionise life perspectives, fostering confidence in decision-making and empowering individuals to make choices with heightened self-assurance
en.highlightText: Human Design acts as a personalized energetic blueprint or "user manual" that helps you understand how you naturally function and make decisions, reduce burnout, and improves relationship.

en.title: Palmistry & Tarot Reading
en.subtitle: Personal Self Discovery By Ida Ayu Citra Kusuma
en.description: Rooted in the science of Jyotisa and the Balinese calendar system, it combines traditional calculations with intuitive interpretation. This Jyotisa methodology will be able to provide a very special wellness treatment through a birth approach called Oton A Pratiti reader will analyze your unique birth date, time, and natural influences to interpret the symbolic patterns that shape your life
en.highlightText: The goal is to foster self-awareness, help you understand your strengths and challenges, and identify ways to balance your emotional and spiritual energies.

en.title: Mandala Making Meditation
en.subtitle: Self Reflection Through Flowers Art Meditation
en.description: Flower mandalas have been used for centuries as a powerful tool for self-reflection, healing, and spiritual growth body. you will learn the art of flower mandala making step-by-step. We provide a wide array of fresh, vibrant flowers and a serene and inspiring space for you to unleash your creativity. This experience is open to all who seek solace, self-discovery, and a moment of artistic expression.
en.highlightText: Each petal holds a story, and as you shape your mandala, you’ll witness the beauty of impermanence and the endless cycles of life.

en.title: Lontar Manuscript Writing
en.subtitle: Meditative Craft Through Ancient Manuscript Carving
en.description: Age-old palm leaf manuscripts containing sacred texts, and ancient wisdom, a guide for almost every aspect of Balinese culture, spirituality, and daily life. Try writing on lontar leaves and learn about the Balinese philosophical values embedded in each manuscript into meditative process. A rushed or tense hand will fracture the fragile palm leaf. To carve successfully, the practitioner must naturally slow their breathing and lower their physical tension
en.highlightText: Engaging in this delicate process offers profound mind, body, and soul therapeutic benefits such as sharping your focus, promotes deep state of cognitive, regulates nervous system through the slow breathing of carving process

en.title: Canang Sari Offering
en.subtitle: Self Reflection Through Flowers Art Meditation
en.description: You can now experience the series of offerings that you often see and admire in various Balinese ritual processions first hand, starting from preparing the ingredients, assembling them, to getting to know the naming of each component which is rich in meaning and purpose. Creating beautiful and unique shapes from coconut leaves, bananas and other materials really saves you time, and then arranges them into a grand design.
en.highlightText: Daily offerings made by Balinese Hindus to thank the God (Sang Hyang Widhi Wasa) in praise and prayer. Offering will be seen in the Balinese temple and on small shrines in houses.

en.title: Kumbha Pottery Art Therapy
en.subtitle: Pottery Workshop (Wheel Throwing & Hand Building)
en.description: Healing through creativity with clay studio offering wheel-throwing, hand building, and paint your own piece sessions as a mindful, tactile art practice. This artistic practice promotes a creative satisfaction and therapeutic/meditative focus. Tactile, meditative shaping of clay by hand or on the wheel, reconnecting with playful creativity.
en.highlightText: Pottery making calms your mind through focused creativity, improves body coordination and hand strength, and nurtures your soul by grounding you in the present moment through tactile self-expression.

en.title: Chitra Sutra Art Painting
en.subtitle: Painting and Visual Art Therapy
en.description: A private painting experience inspired by the surrounding scenery, inviting guests to translate what they have felt into color, texture, and form. In this way, water becomes both landscape and metaphor: a force of movement, as a creative release shaped by feeling, reflection, and emotional renewal
en.highlightText: Art and mindfulness are deeply interconnected practices in presence, observation, and intention, when combined, they form a powerful pathway to emotional healing, self-understanding, and spiritual growth.

en.title: Balinese Kamasan Painting
en.subtitle: Visual art Therapy with Balinese Kamasan Maestro, I Wayan Pande Sumantra
en.description: Kamasan painting is a classical, centuries-old Balinese art form originating from the village of Kamasan in the Klungkung Regency of East Bali. A traditional Balinese Kamasan-style painting depicting scenes from the Hindu epic Ramayana. The characters are drawn in the classic wayang kulit puppet aesthetic, featuring slender elongated bodies, almond-shaped almond eyes, and sharp pointed noses. An Authentic Indonesian folklore art style.
en.highlightText: I Wayan Pande Sumantra is a master classical Kamasan painter from Klungkung, Bali, dedicated to preserving and adapting traditional wayang-style art.

en.title: Painting to Music Therapy
en.subtitle: Abstract free hand movement painting through the music by Angela Klees
en.description: Painting to music is a therapeutic wellness practice that blends sound frequencies with free-hand physical movement to release emotional tension, reduce stress, and promote mental clarity. Instead of focusing on the final visual product, this process prioritizes the mindful act of creation, using the rhythm and melody of music to guide your hands across the canvas.
en.highlightText: Painting to music with free-hand movements enhances wellness by reducing stress and unlocking emotional expression through the therapeutic, rhythmic connection between sound and visual creativity.

en.title: Batik Painting
en.subtitle: Traditional Visual Art Therapy
en.description: This hands on experience offers a deeper understanding of one of Indonesia’s most cherished art forms batik, which uses wax-resist dyeing techniques that have been passed down through generations. Guided by skilled batik artisans, you’ll have the chance to create your own unique batik piece. From drawing your design, applying hot wax, to adding colors with natural dyes, every step is a meaningful part of the process.
en.highlightText: Batik is more than a piece of cloth; it is a living philosophy that reflects life, nature, and human connection to the universe. Recognized as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage, Indonesian batik weaves deep meaning into every single stroke and dot drawn with hot wax

en.title: Tatah Sungging
en.subtitle: Wood Carving Experiences
en.description: Wood carving is woven into the fabric of Balinese life, from the intricate panels of temple gates to the decorative pieces sold in every art market in Ubud. Led by a craftman, your class begins with selecting your wood and your motif, then you'll learn how to hold and move the chisels safely, how to read the grain of the wood, and how to build up a design from rough outline to fine detail.
en.highlightText: Balinese carving draws heavily from Hindu mythology, nature, and geometric patterns, like zentangle shape, this meditative process will improves wellness by lowering stress, encouraging mindfulness, and building physical dexterity through rhythmic, focused handwork

en.title: Wayang Making
en.subtitle: Shadow Puppet Carving Experiences
en.description: In this practice you will learn how to craft a wayang kulit, an ancient form of shadow puppet storytelling art that uses carved leather shaped into characters from the story. The performance is led by a master storyteller called Dalang. The making process involves very careful sketching, carving, chiselling, and colouring. You'll choose a character in a folklore to make but you also have the liberty to sketch your own drawing.
en.highlightText: This art form is not just a visual display but a spiritual and educational medium used to pass down moral values and epic legends through the slow pace meditative carving process.

en.title: Alankara Jewelry Experience
en.subtitle: Silver Jewelry Making
en.description: Silver jewelry making is one of Bali's most celebrated traditional crafts, and in Ubud, you can learn it directly from a master silversmith. You will guided through the fundamental techniques of Balinese silversmithing; shaping, soldering, and finishing sterling silver into a piece of jewelry you design yourself. No prior experience is needed.
en.highlightText: Making silver jewelry improves your mental focus, builds fine motor skills, and nourishes your soul through creative self-expression.

en.title: Mask Painting Experience
en.subtitle: Mask Painting Experience by The Mask Maker, I Komang Mega
en.description: Spend the day with a local family in Mas, one of Bali’s most famous mask-carving villages. Meet the mask maker I Komang Mega, and witness his renowned wood-carving firsthand. Begin the painting process next, as you listen to ancestral stories of magic behind the masks and the symbol of expression for each mask. Delight in these intimate exchanges and take your creation home, a cherished souvenir of the day’s experience.
en.highlightText: Engaging in this ancient practice allows you to tap into centuries of Balinese Hindu philosophy, where art acts as a physical conduit between the seen world (sekala) and the unseen spiritual world (niskala)

en.title: Balinese Dance Meditation
en.subtitle: An Immersive Cultural Dance Learning Experiences
en.description: Balinese dance is one of UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritages of Humanity, a sacred performance tradition that has been refined over centuries. Your lesson introduces you to the foundational vocabulary of Balinese classical dance: the characteristic wide-eyed gaze (tedong), the expressive hand gestures (mudras), the grounded stance, and the basic foot patterns. You will work slowly and carefully to feel the precision and intention behind each movement
en.highlightText: Balinese dance is form of practice that keeps distractions at bay and centers your mind in the present. It performed barefoot, which symbolizes a connection to the earth and the precision in the eye movements sharpening your focus and grounding you mentally.

en.title: Balinese Gamelan Meditation
en.subtitle: An Immersive Cultural Music Learning Experiences
en.description: The sound of gamelan is the sound of Bali. The instruments, bronze keys and gongs arranged in an interlocking ensemble, produce a layered, hypnotic music. The class begins by helping you understand how gamelan music works: its cyclical structure, the interlocking patterns between instruments, and the role each instrument plays in the ensemble. The sound of bronze piece repeating cycle is an incredibly satisfying experience
en.highlightText: This traditional ensemble orchestra utilizes hand-forged bronze gongs, metallophones, and bamboo flutes to tap into a uniquely restorative frequency for Anxiety reduction, cardiovascular regulation, spiritual resonance and joyful feeling.

en.title: Kecak Dance Art Performance
en.subtitle: An Immersive Cultural Dance Performance Experiences
en.description: Kecak Uluwatu is one of Bali’s most iconic cultural performances: a dramatic sunset dance at Uluwatu Temple that combines rhythmic group chanting, Ramayana storytelling, and a spectacular cliffside setting above the ocean. At Uluwatu, it is performed in an open-air setting near the temple, timed with sunset, which gives the performance its famous combination of chant, fire, myth, and ocean panorama.
en.highlightText: What makes it special is its spiritual and visual atmosphere. The dance is rooted in elements of the sacred Sanghyang tradition and was developed into its theatrical form in the 1930s

en.title: Balinese living Museum
en.subtitle: An Immersive Cultural Balinese Visit Experience at Samsara Living Museum
en.description: Welcome to the Balinese authentic cultural sanctuaries: Samsara Living Museum. A living expression of Balinese life, created to protect, preserve, and reinterpret the values, rituals, and wisdom of Bali through everyday practice. Samsara is one of the beliefs of Hindus, particularly in Bali, the Island of God. It is about the stages of life, characterized by various ceremonies and traditional rituals
en.highlightText: In this Living Museum, the Interesting narratives and explanations about the Balinese life cycle will be displayed in a series of meaningful visuals. You also able to see the Arak (Bali Spirit) making and how the old manuscript preserved

en.title: Tejakula Wayang Wong Art Performance
en.subtitle: An Immersive Cultural Dance Performance Experiences
en.description: Wayang Wong Tejakula is a sacred traditional art form believed to have originated in the 17th century and passed down through generations. It draws upon the Ramayana epic, featuring characters such as Rama, Sita, Laksamana, Rahwana, Hanoman, Sugriwa, Subali, Wibisana, Anggada, Kumbakarna, and the Punakawan, alongside armies of wanara (monkeys) and giants
en.highlightText: Performances are typically held as part of religious ceremonies, specifically during Pahing and Umanis Galungan, with the cast size and duration adjusted to suit the specific story and ceremonial requirements.

venues: All Over Bali during Balinese New Year Eve

en.title: Ogoh-Ogoh Cultural Parade
en.subtitle: An Immersive Cultural Festival Experiences
en.description: Ogoh-ogoh are large ceremonial effigies in Bali, created to symbolize negative energies and spiritual imbalance. Traditionally paraded on the eve of Nyepi, they represent the ritual cleansing of chaos before the island enters a sacred day of silence, reflection, and renewal. This giant statue often burned or symbolically destroyed at the end of the night to purify the community and wipe away negative energy
en.highlightText: Ogoh-Ogoh parade provides a profound form of holistic catharsis, offering unique psychological, somatic, and spiritual renewal for your mind, body, and soul. Far more than a vibrant street carnival, this ritual serves as an intense collective exhale.
